display.purpose: The protein 'to go' figure only, in protein blue.

body.purpose: Sentences, meal names and button labels; tabular numerals on globally.

label.purpose: Panel headers, field labels and the picker title; muted, all-small-caps.

data.purpose: Figures, times, panel meta and footers, and the status line. Never sentences.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The world has no drop shadows; depth is ground, panel, raised and well tones on 1px seams.

shadows.name: drawn-outline
shadows.purpose: Drawn outlines only (open status ring at 1.5px, today's score bar, future cells at --seam); never lift.

motion.name: roll
motion.purpose: Numbers roll from previous to new value.

motion.name: scale-in-place
motion.purpose: Bars and score fills scale along one axis; graph cells change colour over 420ms.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Primary fill and photo dim on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: 1ms durations; rolls jump to final value

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 280px; height: 52px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; font: 600 15px var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); background: var(--accent, #1f6feb); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #2f7cf3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.99; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 84px; height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #353c47); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font: 500 15px var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); background: var(--panel, #151a21); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #8b949e); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The console panel: small-caps header with mono meta, 12px body, optional mono footer, all on 1px seams.

components.css: .ds-panel { width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #262c36); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); background: var(--panel, #151a21); font-family: var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #262c36); color: var(--muted, #8b949e); } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-panel-head span, .ds-panel-foot { font: 400 0.75rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 12px; } .ds-score { font: 600 2.1rem/1 var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-sofar { color: var(--muted, #8b949e); font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-panel-foot { padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--seam, #262c36); color: var(--muted, #8b949e); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Recessed well input with small-caps label and in-field mono unit.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 160px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--muted, #8b949e); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-unit-wrap { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 3.2em 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #353c47); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font: 400 15px var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); background: var(--well, #10151c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); } .ds-unit { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; color: var(--muted, #8b949e); font: 400 0.8rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Status Line
components.description: Mono status row: date left, streak status right, led by a ring-or-filled status dot.
components.html: sat 03 oct18d streak · today open
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 340px; min-height: 28px; color: var(--muted, #8b949e); font: 400 0.75rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-streak { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--muted, #8b949e); } .ds-dot[data-state='hit'] { background: var(--protein, #79c0ff); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Macro Row
components.description: Mono row with a 4px mini bar in the macro's data hue; over target reads 'over' in muted, never red.
components.html: carbs96 g left/240
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.4em 1fr 6.2em 3.6em; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 340px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font: 400 0.82rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); } .ds-row > :nth-child(3), .ds-row > :nth-child(4) { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #8b949e); } .ds-mini { display: block; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--graph-0, #1b222c); } .ds-mini span { display: block; height: 100%; transform-origin: left center; transition: scale 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.name: Regular Tile
components.description: Bare photo tile: 4:3 photo, two-line name, caption row with protein in mono and a 1x portion tab.
components.html: 38 g
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 110px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-family: var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); } .ds-tile-log { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: inherit; text-align: left; background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-photo { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8a4b2a, #d08a3c); transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile-log:hover .ds-photo { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-tile-log:active .ds-photo { outline: 2px solid var(--protein, #79c0ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tile-name { min-height: 2.5em; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-tile-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-tile-protein { color: var(--protein, #79c0ff); font: 400 0.8rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); } .ds-tab { padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #353c47); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted, #8b949e); font: 400 0.7rem var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border-color: var(--muted, #8b949e); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contribution Graph
components.description: Protein streak as week columns of square cells stepping graph-0 to graph-4; today outlined, future empty.
components.css: .ds-graph { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(7, 14px); grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 14px; gap: 3px; } .ds-graph span { border-radius: 2px; background: var(--graph-0, #1b222c); transition: background-color 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-graph [data-level='1'] { background: var(--graph-1, #2c3e52); } .ds-graph [data-level='2'] { background: var(--graph-2, #3c5976); } .ds-graph [data-level='3'] { background: var(--graph-3, #4f79a0); } .ds-graph [data-level='4'] { background: var(--graph-4, #79c0ff); } .ds-graph [data-today] { outline: 1px solid var(--text, #e6edf3); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-graph [data-future] { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--seam, #262c36); }

components.name: Undo Toast
components.description: Raised strip above the dock with one line and an underlined Undo.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 320px; min-height: 48px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #353c47); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font: 400 0.88rem var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); background: var(--raised, #1b2129); } .ds-toast > span { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-undo { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: inherit; font: 600 15px var(--font-ui, Geist, sans-serif); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-undo:hover { background: var(--panel, #151a21); } .ds-undo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-edge, #388bfd); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Your nutrition as a console you would build for yourself. A graphite ground carries a faint dot grid; graphite panels sit on it, joined by 1px seams, each with a small-caps header, a body, and sometimes a mono footer. Figures are monospaced and tabular. The colours that carry meaning are borrowed from syntax highlighting, and they mark data and state, never decoration. The protein streak is drawn as a contribution graph.

The game layer is the instrument's own readout: a 0–100 day score, a protein streak, a 12-week consistency graph and the next milestone. It uses the same seams, cells and figures as everything else, with nothing celebratory on top. An unfinished day is drawn as unfinished, a missed day is a dim cell, and a value over target is stated plainly in muted text.

Density is that of a tool checked one-handed at the table. It uses a single 560px column, compact 12px panel padding and 44px touch targets everywhere, including around compact controls. The only imagery is the owner's own meal photos.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first graphite ground (#0d1117) with a 1px dot grid at 5% opacity on a 16px pitch.
Panels on 1px seams, one elevation step, no drop shadows.
Four syntax-derived data colours: protein, kcal, carbs, fat.
One blue primary accent, used only by the primary action.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for figures, times and the status line.
Motion is in place and on one axis: numbers roll, bars scale, panels expand.

rules.name: The Data-Only Rule
rules.body: Protein, kcal, carbs and fat colours mark data and state. They are never used for ornament, backgrounds, borders or buttons.

rules.name: The One Commit Rule
rules.body: The blue accent appears only on the primary action: one filled button per view, plus the checked checkbox. Every other button is a graphite outline.

rules.name: The No Red Intake Rule
rules.body: Danger red is for destructive hover and system failure only. Intake over target is shown with the word "over" in muted text, never in red.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets figures, times and the status line only. Sentences, names and buttons stay in Geist. Mono is never a costume.

rules.name: The Small Caps Header Rule
rules.body: Panel headers are lowercase source text set in all-small-caps, never uppercase strings, never in mono.

rules.name: The One Step Rule
rules.body: Panel to raised is the only elevation step. Hover fills, the toast and the picker head use raised. Nothing sits above raised except a modal sheet.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px seam (seam or seam-strong). If something needs to stand apart, give it a seam, not a shadow or a glow.

dos: Do separate surfaces with 1px seams (seam #262c36) and convey depth only through ground, panel, raised and well tones.
Do reserve Commit Blue (#1f6feb) for the single primary action in view and the checked checkbox.
Do colour a figure by what it measures: protein #79c0ff, kcal #d2a8ff, carbs #e3b341, fat #7ee787.
Do set figures, times and the status line in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, and everything else in Geist.
Do set panel headers in muted all-small-caps at 0.8rem with +0.06em tracking.
Do draw an unfinished day as unfinished, with "so far", an outlined "now" bar, and an open status ring.
Do put every bar of a comparison on one shared scale, and draw references (such as an average) as dashed lines.
Do animate change in place, rolling numbers and scaling bars over 420ms with ease-out, and honour reduced motion.
Do keep every touch target at 44px, extending compact controls with an invisible hit area.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, glows or a second elevation step.
Don't fill any button other than the primary action with blue, or use blue as decoration.
Don't use danger red (#f85149) for intake, totals or "over" values. It is only for destructive hover and system failure.
Don't set sentences, names or buttons in Geist Mono to look technical.
Don't add confetti, mascots, stickers, levels, badges or guilt copy. A missed day is a dim cell, not a scolding.
Don't break a streak mid-day or compare today's partial score against finished days as if it were complete.
Don't frame regulars as cards, or nest boxes inside the portion picker.
Don't use imagery other than the owner's meal photos.
